It is believed that the name Chhagan carries the blessings of Lord Kubera, bringing wealth, prosperity, and success in all endeavors. The name is also associated with the idea of providing shelter or protection to those around, making it an honorable and respected name in Hindu culture.

The name resonates with the spiritual values of Hinduism, such as prosperity, happiness, and good fortune, and is considered to be a source of inspiration and motivation for individuals to strive for success and prosperity in life.
